category.name: Design and UI
category.description: Read and write design files, generate branded graphics and publish websites.

entries.name: Canva Connect API
entries.auth_hint: OAuth2 Authorization Code + PKCE (SHA-256); Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
entries.free_tier: check pricing (free to build/test; public apps require Canva review before production use)
entries.desc_en: Programmatically create, autofill, and export Canva designs, and manage assets and comments via a REST API.
entries.notes: Auth is OAuth2 only (no raw API key/static token option). Apps using preview/beta scopes cannot pass Canva's required review for production/public use. A general apps llms.txt exists at canva.dev/docs/apps/llms.txt but no Connect-specific one was found.

entries.name: Figma REST API / Dev Mode MCP
entries.free_tier: free: personal access tokens work on free plan, rate-limited per seat/plan tier; MCP free during beta
entries.desc_en: Read and write Figma file/comment/component data via REST, and feed live design context to coding agents via the official Dev Mode MCP server.
entries.notes: REST API rate limits vary by seat/plan (e.g. Tier 1 ~10-20 req/min), returns 429 with Retry-After. Remote MCP (mcp.figma.com/mcp) works on all plans and is free during beta, will move to usage-based pricing; local desktop MCP variant requires a paid Dev/Full seat.

entries.name: Framer
entries.auth_hint: Project-scoped API key generated in Site Settings, passed to the framer-api SDK's connect() function
entries.free_tier: check pricing (no separate API fee found; scoped to a Framer project/site plan)
entries.desc_en: Automate publishing of Framer sites programmatically (get project info, publish previews, promote to production) via a Node SDK.
entries.notes: Framer's genuine server-side surface is narrow: the Server API (npm package framer-api) only covers publish/deploy automation, not general design editing. The in-editor Plugin API, Code Components, and Fetch are for the visual editor/site runtime, not agent-callable server-side. No MCP server confirmed; 'External Agents' docs reference coding-agent workflows (Claude Code/Cursor) rather than a formal MCP endpoint.

entries.name: Penpot API
entries.free_tier: free tier: free cloud account (design.penpot.app) plus free, open-source self-hosting
entries.desc_en: Read, create, and modify Penpot design files, comments, and webhooks via a token-authenticated RPC/REST API, or via the official MCP server.
entries.notes: API is RPC-style (e.g. /api/rpc/command/get-profile) with auto-generated reference docs, not a conventional OpenAPI/Swagger file. Fully open source; can be self-hosted. MCP server repo: github.com/penpot/penpot/tree/develop/mcp.

entries.name: v0 Platform API (Vercel)
entries.free_tier: check pricing (usage-based; credits included on v0 Premium/Team plans, no separate free API key tier confirmed)
entries.desc_en: Generate full UI/frontend code from natural-language prompts, iterate via chat, and deploy the result directly to Vercel via REST API.
entries.notes: Different product from Vercel's core platform API; API access is tied to v0 plan credits rather than a standalone free signup. No MCP server confirmed for v0 specifically.

entries.name: Webflow Data API
entries.free_tier: check pricing (API access itself is free with a token; some CMS/publish actions require the site to be on a paid Webflow plan)
entries.desc_en: Create/update CMS collections, items, and pages, and publish Webflow sites programmatically via REST API or the official MCP server.
entries.notes: Three token types: Site tokens (single site), Workspace tokens (multi-site read-only), OAuth tokens (multi-site apps). Official SDKs exist but specific languages weren't confirmed in docs excerpt; rate limits documented separately under 'Rate Limiting'.
